sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:
The core gameplay mechanics of Falling Blocks Mobile are simple yet challenging. The game requires you to drop down blocks and complete as many horizontal lines as possible. The blocks are made up of four different shapes, which include a T-shaped block, an L-shaped block, a square block, and a Z-shaped block.

The game starts with a single block, and as the game progresses, the blocks fall down faster and faster. You'll need to rotate the blocks, adjust their position, and time them perfectly to clear as many lines as possible.

One of the key features of Falling Blocks Mobile is its scoring system. The game rewards you with points for every line you clear, and the points increase as the game progresses. You'll also get bonus points for clearing multiple lines at once, and you'll get a multiplier bonus for completing lines in quick succession.

To play Falling Blocks Mobile, you'll need to use your mouse, keyboard, or touch controls to rotate the blocks, adjust their position, and time them perfectly. The game also features a undo feature, which allows you to undo your last move and try again.

The game's core gameplay mechanics are simple yet challenging, making it a great game for anyone looking for a fun and addictive puzzle game.
